overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating over email. The violation was cured in part by the public deliberation at the December 14, 2010 meeting, and the Committee was ordered to release the emails.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the School Committee deliberated by email, with a quorum, on approving an Acceptable Use of Technology Policy.
allegations.key_passage: However, the email exchange that occurred following her expression of an opinion to the Subcommittee on a topic under consideration by the Subcommittee constituted a deliberation outside a properly convened meeting.

remedy: Release the email exchange between Subcommittee members in which the Acceptable Use of Technology Policy was discussed, if not already released.
remedy_passage: In order to completely cure the violation, we order the Committee to release the email exchange between members of the Subcommittee in which the Acceptable Use of Technology Policy was discussed, if it has not done so already.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
